scope: Read-only technical branch/reference/counter audit; sensitive narrative and image content omitted.

flow.action: Routes to6667792 when enemy HP<=0; otherwise6667791.
Initial terminal-state scene sets unique_slave[erza]=1 before either follow-up selection. The ordinary interaction_city tail calls interaction_result_city before first display.

existingState.uniqueErza: The city entry menu permits the encounter only when unique_slave[erza]=0. Both surviving and terminal branches set it to1. It cannot distinguish pending follow-up from selected follow-up.
existingState.genericCompletion: interaction_city tail GT interaction_result_city; its common final block increments city_already_done_today[$str(interaction_city)] and city_already_done_ever[$str(interaction_city)] before GT interaction_screen_city.

recommendedOnceBoundary.guard: Only award when both city_already_done_ever string keys66677921 and66677922 are0.
recommendedOnceBoundary.commit: Use the existing unconditional interaction_result_city completion increment in the same event execution. Do not manually increment a second time.
recommendedOnceBoundary.keyType: Use string keys as the existing $str(interaction_city) writer does; do not substitute huge numeric array positions.
recommendedOnceBoundary.uniqueRole: Optional prerequisite validation can use unique_slave[erza], but that value alone is not a completed-selection flag.
recommendedOnceBoundary.repeatDisplay: Gate only the score side effect; a repeated handler may still configure its image/text and proceed to the ordinary renderer without another score. An early EXIT after the controller cleared text arrays can leave an unusable old display.
recommendedOnceBoundary.crossChoice: The combined two-key guard prevents a later opposite selection from adding another score. Currently no independent persistent cross-choice outcome lock exists.
recommendedOnceBoundary.legacyCounters: Any existing positive counter for either follow-up means no retroactive award.

cachedSaveCases.case: First-page save with embedded choice links
cachedSaveCases.result: Cached links call the current interaction_city handler. A first selection can use the new score guard and complete the existing counter transaction.

cachedSaveCases.case: Legacy first page without choice links
cachedSaveCases.result: The current scene renderer checks cached text for its choice marker; no marker retains the ordinary forward exit instead of locking the page.

cachedSaveCases.case: Save already on a follow-up result
cachedSaveCases.result: Saved $text and $special_image arrays can retain the previous shared image until a fresh event execution. Do not rerun settlement merely to refresh graphics or award retroactive score.

cachedSaveCases.case: Stale/returned first-page links after a selection
cachedSaveCases.result: Ordinary UI replaces the choice page, but direct stale-link invocation is not blocked by either existing follow-up handler. Combined ever-counter guards make both same/opposite subsequent score additions zero.

cachedSaveCases.case: Both old follow-up counters already positive
cachedSaveCases.result: Existing counters establish completion but not historical choice order. Do not guess or migrate an old choice; award zero.
